title: Bills of Lading and Transport Documents: telex release against surrender of the full set at origin
content:
## Scope

This Bills of Lading and Transport Documents policy governs the telex release: a release that lets the consignee take delivery without presenting an original, because the shipper has surrendered the originals at origin.

## Clauses in force

1. A telex release is offered only on tiers on which telex release is available.
2. Only the documentation party holding the record may request a telex release, a correction or a switch bill.
3. The request is registered first and waits for the shipper, who alone can hand in the originals.
4. A telex release is effected only after the full set of originals has been surrendered at the origin office, so that no originals of the document remain outstanding.
5. The surrender is recorded as originals surrendered at the origin office for the set in force, and the document moves to the status surrendered. Destination release then follows under the destination release rules.
6. A telex release fee, at the tier's telex release fee, is charged to the documentation party.
7. A telex release fee is booked only on a document whose status is surrendered.
8. A release request is charged at most once.
9. A telex release cannot be revoked once the document is surrendered.

## Retired clause (no longer in force)

The former wording of clause 6 added an exception: the fee was not charged when the documentation party held an active service contract whose tier rank was at least the tier's minimum waiver rank, a minimum of 0 meaning that no contract exempted the fee. That exception is no longer in force. It has been superseded by the current basis for the telex release fee, and must not be applied as written here.

## The request, in order of effect

Request by the documentation party holding the record → request registered → shipper surrenders the full set at the origin office → document surrendered, none outstanding → release effected, fee chargeable → destination release.

## Points of judgement

- **A consignee or other party asks for the telex release.** Only the documentation party holding the record may request it.
- **Some, but not all, of the originals have been handed in.** The release is not effected; the full set must be surrendered.
- **The customer wishes to cancel after the document is surrendered.** A telex release cannot be revoked once the document is surrendered.
- **Hypothetical case:** the same release request is presented for charging a second time. It is not charged again; a release request is charged at most once.

superseded_clauses: except when the documentation party holds an active service contract whose tier rank is at least the tier's telex_fee_waiver_min_contract_rank, a value of 0 meaning that no contract exempts the fee.
